root_scope_cautions.relational_reciprocity: Ordered relation inversion is not automatically reciprocity. A directional relation may keep the same written marker while argument order supplies direction. Before testing, freeze the endpoint-role interpretation and a predicted difference that is not already the observed swap; invariant marker shape alone is not a falsifier.
root_scope_cautions.kind_identity: Material-kind reference is a specialization of the existing class/slot versus member question. An individual-referencing expression can select different individuals in different records, and a kind need not be explicitly named in every eligible instance. Freeze a rigid individual versus declared class-production model before treating recurrence/nonrecurrence as discrimination.
root_scope_cautions.material_conservation: Transport and transformation can coexist; transport may change state and a chemical transformation may change material-kind identity. The current contrast requires a declared pure-transport rival and an explicit sense of conserved identity, such as one tracked material through a phase change. It does not test all transformations or all flow accounts.

scope: Original conceptual drafts preserved; qualifiers expose overlap and prospective method defects without claiming a completed scientific assessment. Independent endpoints are not currently established.
